digits.description: Numerals used for dates: Persian (۱۴۰۵) or Latin (1405).
digits.label: Digits

events_ancient.description: Pre-Islamic and Zoroastrian festivals such as Mehregan, Sadeh and Yalda.
events_ancient.label: Ancient Iranian festivals

font_size.description: Font size for the bar widget in pixels. 0 follows the bar's own size.
font_size.label: Bar font size

format.description: Template for the bar widget. Placeholders: {day} {month} {year} {weekday}.
format.label: Bar format

language.description: Script used for month and weekday names, and the direction of the grid.
language.label: Language

scale.description: Scales the calendar panel's text and cells. 1.0 is the default size.
scale.label: Calendar size

show_glyph.description: Show an icon next to the date on the bar.
show_glyph.label: Show icon

show_gregorian.description: Show the Gregorian day number in each cell.
show_gregorian.label: Show Gregorian

show_hijri.description: Show the lunar Islamic day number in each cell.
show_hijri.label: Show Hijri Qamari

show_holidays.description: Mark official Iranian holidays and list each day's occasions.
show_holidays.label: Show holidays

week_start.description: Which weekday the grid starts on. Saturday matches the Iranian week.
week_start.label: First day of week
